name: RBM Infra - a less discussed SME

posts.author: AMANDEEPSINHA

posts.text: Seems the company is available at reasonable valuation but auditor resignation is a key issue…also related party transactions should be disclosed which the company is refusing to disclose…also will there be lot of dilution once warrants are exercised due to which the company is trading cheaper?
